description: Creates branches for multiple source LiveDocs and returns an asynchronous `jobs` resource. Each `documentConfigurations` entry supplies a source and may specify its own target; omitted targets stay with the source location. Requires source read and target write permissions; poll `getJob` for completion. Use `branchDocument` for one document. Effect: triggers a server-side action rather than a plain resource creation — whether repeating it is safe, a no-op, or rejected depends on the specific action; treat it as not guaranteed idempotent. Tip: set `dry_run: true` first to validate the arguments and preview the exact request without sending it to Polarion. The executor returns this preview as normal text, and as structured content when the tool declares an output schema.

dry_run.description: If true, validates the request and returns the exact request that would be sent to Polarion — with the Authorization header redacted and any binary payload summarized by byte length — without actually sending it.

copyWorkflowStatusAndSignatures.description: Specifies that workflow status and signatures should be copied to the branched document.

initializedFields.description: Specifies fields of overwritten Work Items that should be initialized (instead of being copied from source Work Items).

overwriteWorkItems.description: Specifies that Work Items in the branched Document should be overwritten (instead of being referenced).

sourceDocument.description: Reference path of the source Document.

targetProjectId.description: Project where new document will be created.

targetSpaceId.description: Space where new document will be created.

updateTitleHeading.description: Specifies that title heading of the target Document should be set to the new Document's title.

name: branchDocuments
